title: Modernizing the PlayCanvas Backend Infrastructure
summary: PlayCanvas is the leading HTML5 game engine powering 3D experiences and games on many of the world’s most popular websites. PlayCanvas joined Snap in 2017 to help build Snap Games, Snapchat’s multiplayer gaming platform.
